title: Serverless Compute: Cloud Run, Functions, and Workflows — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates container cold-start latency spike and concurrency saturation: demonstrates min-instances configuration eliminating cold starts under surge.
routing_rationale: Setting min-instances maintains warm container replicas, ensuring zero-latency request handling during unpredictable traffic spikes.

nodes.label: Concurrency Monitor

steps.title: Zero-Latency Absorption
steps.action: 5,000 QPS influx arrives; pre-warmed min-instances absorb first wave instantly.
steps.why_traversal: Min-instances eliminates cold-start penalty for critical user journeys.

steps.title: Scale-Out Trigger
steps.action: Concurrency governor detects 80% saturation on warm instances; calls rapid scaler.
steps.why_traversal: Predictive scaling prevents container memory exhaustion.

steps.title: Fleet Expansion
steps.action: Autoscaler launches 90 additional container instances across multiple zones.
steps.why_traversal: Accommodates full 5,000 QPS load while maintaining sub-80ms p95 latency.

scenarios.label: Downstream Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
scenarios.root_cause: 100 Cloud Run instances each opened 20 direct connections to PostgreSQL (2,000 total).
scenarios.diverted_path: Cloud SQL rejects new TCP connections with 'FATAL: sorry, too many clients already'.
scenarios.blast_radius: All API endpoints requiring database queries fail.
scenarios.recovery: Deploy Cloud SQL Auth Proxy with built-in connection pooling or use PgBouncer.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
